# linear_emoji (Resource)

Manages a custom emoji in the Linear workspace.

Linear has no update mutation for emoji, so changing either attribute replaces the resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "linear_emoji" "shipit" {
  name = "shipit"
  url  = "https://assets.example.com/emoji/shipit.png"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name the emoji is typed as, without colons, e.g. `shipit`. Changing it replaces the emoji.
- `url` (String) URL of the image Linear fetches. Changing it replaces the emoji.

### Read-Only

- `hosted_url` (String) URL of Linear's own copy of the image, which is what the workspace serves.
- `id` (String) UUID of the emoji.
- `source` (String) Where the emoji came from, as Linear records it.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID.
terraform import linear_emoji.example a1b2c3d4-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
